about_the_game:
In the exciting new game "Poor Piggy Pirate" you steer your adorable piggy buccaneer (and other pets) through dangerous waters.

Beware of the fierce bunny pirates and other dangers along the way. And of course: collect as much yummy fruit as possible to earn the highscore!

"Poor Pirate Piggy" is a cute retro pixelart adventure for the whole family!

Features:

🐷 adorable retro pixel graphics
🏝 randomly generated levels with islands, rocks, seamines and other dangers
⚔️ fun fast-paced gameplay
👾 loads of enemy types
🍉 several kinds of fruit to collect
🐾 unlock dozens of cute little animals to play as!
